title: Channel Development Manager
description:
At Replicant, we believe AI should work for people, starting with customer service. That’s why we built a platform that helps contact centers resolve more requests, proactively identify issues, and improve agent performance with AI-powered conversation intelligence and AI agents that act like your best reps.

Our AI agents handle millions of calls every month for Fortune 500 companies and high-growth innovators. From processing payments to booking appointments and authenticating users, they help customers get what they need instantly, 24/7. Meanwhile, our real-time conversation insights help contact center leaders coach better and improve every interaction.

We’re leading the shift from legacy systems to AI-first service, powered by large language models (LLMs) and designed for enterprise scale, security, and empathy. If you’re excited by the potential of LLMs, voice AI, and building category-defining technology with a kind, ambitious team, you’ll love it here.

Replicant is hiring a Channel Development Manager to own and grow our distributor and advisor relationships. This is a builder role. You'll work closely with the Channel Leader to drive advisor engagement, sourced pipeline, and revenue through our distributor relationships.

You'll be at the center of our distributor partnerships, co-selling motion, and channel growth strategy, helping establish Replicant as a trusted partner within the advisor community.

What You'll Do

 - Own and deepen relationships with our core distributors (Avant, Telarus, Intelisys) and key institutional practices.

 - Build advisor mindshare through consistent enablement, co-selling, and a strong presence at events.

 - Partner directly with advisors on active opportunities, providing the business and technical context they need to position Replicant effectively with customers.

 - Drive sourced pipeline from first conversation through closed business, partnering closely with Account Executives throughout the sales cycle.

 - Develop and execute strategies to increase advisor engagement, referrals, and pipeline generation.

 - Help shape the channel program as we scale, contributing to the playbooks, positioning, and processes that make partners successful.

What We're Looking For

 - 1-2 years of experience in channel sales

 - 4+ years of experience in sales, partner sales, or business development.

 - Hands-on experience working with distributors, advisors, agents, or channel partners.

 - A proven track record of sourcing pipeline and driving revenue through partner ecosystems.

 - Strong relationship-building and communication skills with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders.

 - Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

 - Existing relationships within the distributor and advisor ecosystem are strongly preferred.

 - Willingness to travel for distributor events, advisor meetings, customer engagements, and industry conferences.

Success in This Role

 - Generate and influence meaningful pipeline and revenue through distributor and advisor relationships.

 - Increase advisor engagement and activation across strategic distributor partners.

 - Create repeatable co-selling motions that consistently produce qualified opportunities.

 - Expand Replicant's visibility and mindshare within the advisor ecosystem.

 - Establish trusted relationships that lead advisors to proactively bring Replicant into customer conversations.

For all full-time employees, we offer:

 In-person connection that counts: company-wide offsites and smaller team gatherings designed to make remote work feel personal

️ Tech & learning stipend: Conferences, books, courses — interested? We’ll fund them

 Remote by design: We’re distributed — no guilt about life events, we trust you to manage your calendar

️ Health & wellness: Flexible vacations, paid sabbatical after 5 years, comprehensive benefits, plus a stipend to support your physical and mental well-being

 Compensation that matches your impact: competitive salaries in the company you’re helping to build

 Equity with upside: We believe in shared ownership—You’ll own a real piece of a fast-growing AI company

Our Values

Replicant has three core values. It is critical that everyone who joins the team feels excited and moved by these values as every new team member makes an impact on our culture.

Blade Runners: We take ownership and pride to influence the outcomes of our goals. We are successful, and like a Blade Runner, use the tools at our disposal to reach our objectives. We value open and honest communication and proactively seek feedback along the way. We are a company driven to grow and achieve both individually and as a team.

Bread Makers: We are humble and strive toward an egalitarian culture. No task is too big or too small. We work together to achieve our goals and develop our company mission. We believe that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts in everything that we do.

Självdistans (Self-Distance): Självdistans is Swedish for self-distance. It's the ability to critically reflect on oneself and one's relations from an external perspective. With this in mind, we act with objectivity and always remember that we are not our work. There's no perfect science to growing a team or business, but we trust everyone at Replicant to point out our blind spots and humbly admit their own.

Replicant is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at talent@replicant.ai hr@replicant.ai and we’ll work to meet your needs.

title: Account Manager
description:
Your professional transformation starts here

Are you full of great ideas? Do you dream of building a greener future as part of a company that values your skills and opinions? Are you looking for a flexible employer that will give you the opportunity to grow within the company?

This job is for you!

About the Role
Sanimax is recruiting on behalf of its partner company, Entosystem, an environmentally focused organization specializing in the production of high-value protein and organic fertilizer through innovative insect farming. Founded in 2016, Entosystem has grown to become one of the largest insect producers in North America, leveraging advanced technologies to support sustainable and circular solutions for the agri-food industry.

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Account Manager to accelerate our expansion across retail brands and distribution networks in the United States.

This role is designed for a true “builder / hunter” who thrives on opening new accounts, developing strategic opportunities, and closing high-value commercial agreements.

You will play a key role in strengthening our North American presence by building a targeted pipeline, securing long-term partnerships, and positioning the company as a trusted partner within the market.

This is not a traditional account management role — this position focuses on market development and new business creation.

Why Join Sanimax?
• High-impact role with direct influence on U.S. market expansion

• Opportunity to build strategic accounts from the ground up

• Exposure to large, well-known retail and distribution players

• Entrepreneurial environment with strong autonomy and decision-making power

• Fast-growing company with ambitious North American growth objectives

• Collaborative culture focused on performance, innovation, and partnership

Key Responsibilities
Business Development
• Identify and target new strategic accounts, including consumer brands and retail chains (farm & ranch, pet, convenience, specialty)

• Develop and execute a structured prospecting strategy

• Build and manage a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities

• Generate and convert high-value opportunities into signed agreements

Sales & Negotiation
• Engage directly with key stakeholders such as Buyers, Category Managers, and Sourcing teams

• Lead complex negotiations and structure long-term commercial agreements (12–24 months)

• Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing

Strategic Account Development
• Establish and maintain relationships with key decision-makers

• Position the company as a long-term strategic partner

• Identify and develop account growth opportunities

• Support the expansion of major accounts across the U.S. market

Experience
• 7 to 15+ years of experience in B2B sales

• Proven success in new business development and complex sales cycles

• Experience working with retail chains, distributors, or consumer brands

Skills & Competencies
• Established network within relevant industries (livestock, pet feed, retail, or distribution)

• Strong negotiation, deal structuring, and closing skills

• Ability to navigate complex buying organizations

• Strong business acumen, including pricing, margins, and competitive positioning

• High level of autonomy with a results-oriented mindset

Languages
• Native or near-native English required

• French is considered an asset

Additional Assets
• Existing network within target segments

• Experience managing large U.S. accounts

• Understanding of North American retail dynamics

• Experience in high-growth or market expansion environments

Work Environment
• 40–60% travel across the United States Mid West region; and occasionally in Canada

• Frequent client-facing activities (meetings, site visits, trade shows)

Give meaning to your career and help us make a difference: become a transformation champion!
Follow us on LinkedIn

Thank you for your interest in joining our team. Please note that we will only contact those whose applications are being considered.
At Sanimax, we see strength in diversity, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer

title: Head of Commercial Partnerships
description:
ABOUT US

Cracken is an applied AI lab building world’s first full kill chain proactive cyber platform. Built by cyber warfare-experienced operators and AI researchers Cracken keeps digital infrastructure resilient so businesses and societies operate.

WHOM WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Cracken is entering a scaling phase. Our technology is proven. Our credibility is earned. What we need now is someone to convert that position into a global partnership engine.
As Head of Commercial Partnerships, you will own the strategy and execution of Cracken's partner ecosystem: channel partners, systems integrators, and technology alliances. You will decide which partnerships matter, negotiate them, land them, and build the team that scales them.
This is a builder's role. You will inherit early momentum, not a finished playbook. You will report to the CEO and work directly with the Head of Sales.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Define and own Cracken's global partnership strategy across enterprise, security services, and technology segments

 - Identify, negotiate, and close strategic partnerships that open new markets and revenue channels

 - Build and manage the channel and co-delivery program: resellers, MSSPs, security consultancies, and systems integrators

 - Develop relationships with enterprise buyers, cyber insurance carriers, and institutional commercial partners across global markets

 - Structure technology alliances with platform and infrastructure partners where integration creates joint value

 - Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue with clear attribution and accountability

 - Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, research, legal, and operations to make partnerships deliverable, not just signed

 - Manage key partner relationships personally at the executive level

 - Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing partnerships team as the function scales

 - Represent Cracken at industry events, briefings, and partner forum

MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

 - 10+ years in strategic partnerships, business development, or alliances, with at least 5 in a leadership role

 - Track record of sourcing, negotiating, and closing complex multi-party deals with measurable revenue outcomes

 - Deep experience in at least one of: cybersecurity, enterprise software, or applied AI

 - Fluency with long-cycle institutional sales and complex enterprise procurement

 - Experience building partner programs from an early stage, not just running mature ones

 - Strong commercial judgment: you know which deals to walk away from

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication; comfort presenting to boards, executives, and CISOs alike

 - Willingness to travel internationally

NICE TO HAVE

 - Existing relationships across the security services ecosystem: MSSPs, red team consultancies, systems integrators

 - Relationships in the cyber insurance and specialty markets ecosystem

 - Background working with or selling offensive security, penetration testing, or exposure management technology

 - Experience at a high-growth startup during a scaling phase

 - Familiarity with agentic AI systems and the emerging AI security market

WHO THRIVES HERE

You are a closer who thinks like a strategist. You have carried a number and built a

function. You are comfortable operating without a playbook and disciplined enough to

write one as you go. You understand that in enterprise security, trust is the product,

and you know how to earn it. You want your work to matter beyond the quarter.

Why Cracken?

 - Real-world impact
 Our technology is validated in high-stakes, real-world environments and grounded in hands-on internal research.

 - Team with a mission
 Ukrainian-heavy international team of PhDs, professors, and senior industry engineers, driven by intrinsic motivation and real-world adversity.

 - Adaptive roles
 We shape roles around exceptional talent - your ownership and drive will define your path.

 - Perfect timing
 Operating at the intersection of AI, cybersecurity, and autonomous systems, Cracken is uniquely positioned to build resilient security products.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Ownership over a core cybersecurity product

 - Direct collaboration with founders and senior engineers

 - High autonomy and real impact on product direction

 - Fully remote & flexible work setup

 - Competitive compensation

title: Strategic Partner Manager
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

Start in minutes with a fully managed, scalable Postgres database and a suite of tools that eliminate the complexity of backend development. Use one or use all—Supabase gives teams the flexibility of open source with the speed and simplicity of a modern platform, so they can move fast without sacrificing control.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Strategic Partner Manager to join our team to build and scale Supabase's integration partner ecosystem, including AI Builder partnerships.

You'll own a focused portfolio of high-impact partners across developer tooling, AI builders, and adjacent infrastructure categories. This role is highly execution-oriented: you'll work directly with partners to ship integrations, launch joint GTM motions, and drive measurable adoption, pipeline, and revenue.

This is a high-visibility IC role with direct impact on product adoption, ecosystem expansion, and revenue. You'll be expected to operate with a lot of ownership and little process at the start. If you enjoy writing the playbook and running it in-market, this role will be a good fit.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

PARTNER STRATEGY & OWNERSHIP

 - Own and grow a portfolio of strategic technology and platform partners.

 - Develop and execute joint GTM plans with defined KPIs (0 to 1 in wins, ARR, pipeline, integrations, adoption).

 - Execute expansion opportunities including co-marketing events, co-sell motions, and joint GTM initiatives.

REVENUE & PIPELINE DEVELOPMENT

 - Drive sourced and influenced pipeline through partner relationships.

 - Enable Sales teams with partner positioning, playbooks, and introductions.

 - Collaborate with partners on co-selling opportunities and enterprise deals.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL EXECUTION & MANAGEMENT

 - Work closely with Product and Engineering on integration roadmaps and technical alignment.

 - Coordinate co-marketing initiatives with Marketing (launches, webinars, hackathons, case studies, events).

 - Support partner enablement through training, documentation, and ongoing engagement.

 - Build strong relationships across all levels within the partner organization (from Product/Eng to SA to executives).

 - Track and report on partner performance metrics (ARR, usage, activation, pipeline) while maintaining accurate forecasting and partnership health dashboards.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have ~5 years of experience in partnerships, business development, or platform strategy at a developer tools, cloud, or infrastructure company.

 - Possess a strong understanding of developer ecosystems and modern data / infra stacks.

 - Have demonstrated experience shipping integrations and growing them post-launch.

 - Have experience owning partners end-to-end: sourcing, technical alignment, negotiation, launch, and growth.

 - Are commercially minded and comfortable with deal structures, revenue models, forecasting, and KPIs.

 - Are a clear, concise communicator who can align Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams.

 - Are a highly organized operator who can build programs from scratch and iterate quickly.

 - Are data-driven, outcome-oriented, and comfortable operating in ambiguity within a fast-moving, open-source-first startup environment.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
 
 We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
 
 Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
 
 Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
 
 Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
 
 Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
 
 We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
 
 Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

### About Cornerstone Building Brands

Cornerstone Building Brands is a leading manufacturer of exterior building products for residential and low-rise non-residential buildings in North America. Headquartered in Cary, N.C., we serve residential and commercial customers across the new construction and Repair & Remodel (R&R) markets. Our market-leading portfolio of products spans vinyl windows, vinyl siding, stone veneer, metal roofing, metal wall systems and metal accessories. Cornerstone Building Brands’ broad, multi-channel distribution platform and expansive national footprint includes more than 18,800 team members at manufacturing, distribution and office locations throughout North America. Corporate stewardship and Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) responsibility are embedded in our culture. We are committed to contributing positively to the communities where we live, work and play. For more information, visit us at http://cornerstonebuildingbrands.com.

Job Description

As a Territory Sales Manager for the market leader in windows, you'll be part of a dynamic team where your contributions are valued, and your professional development is prioritized. You will report up to the Manager REgional Sales. Join us and become an integral part of our winning team.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Account Development: Expand and cultivate existing accounts while establishing new ones to drive sales growth
* Sales Forecasting: Provide accurate sales forecasts and conduct competitive analysis to inform strategic decision-making
* Market Analysis: Analyze market segments to identify opportunities for growth and development

* Customer Engagement: Conduct sales promotions, educational meetings, and lead generation activities to foster strong customer relationships. Customize sales presentations driven to increase customers annual sales
* Price Management: Recommend pricing changes within established guidelines based on market dynamics and competitive analysis
* Problem Resolution: Address customer complaints promptly, investigate issues, and recommend solutions to ensure customer satisfaction
* Sales Administration: Maintain thorough sales records, including customer profiles and territory/account sales records

Qualifications

title: Senior Partner Programs Manager
description:
About Acquia

Acquia empowers the world’s most ambitious brands to create digital customer experiences that matter. With open source Drupal at its core, the Acquia Digital Experience Platform (DXP) enables marketers, developers, and IT operations teams at thousands of global organizations to rapidly compose and deploy digital products and services that engage customers, enhance conversions, and help businesses stand out.

Headquartered in Boston, MA, Acquia is a Great Place to Work-CertifiedTM company, is listed as one of the world’s top software companies by The Software Report, and is positioned as a market leader by the analyst community. We are Acquia. We are building for the future and we want you to be a part of it! 

Career Exploration at Acquia 

Our recruitment process is designed to empower you in making the most informed decisions. Acquia is committed to providing an inclusive, transparent, efficient, and educational interview experience that cultivates exploration into career opportunities at Acquia

You will discover the opportunity to grow your career here and learn from a global team that empowers you to exceed boundaries and achieve the extraordinary.

We are looking for a Senior Partner Programs Manager to help build and scale our Partner Programs, Strategy & Operations function. This role is the operating backbone of the Partner organization: you will establish the operating rhythm, drive integrated planning and governance, and create a single source of truth across partner initiatives. You will also be a lead architect of our new Resell Program (rules of engagement, bookings guide, product & pricing book), own our Partner Program Guide, and build the on-ramp playbook that carries new partners from signed agreement through certification. This is a high-visibility role for a partner programs veteran, someone who has built programs from the ground up, is deeply comfortable with partner economics and governance, and is genuinely energized by spending time with partners. This role reports directly into Director, Partners and will be a key partner to Sales, Channel, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Legal.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Program Design & Partner Lifecycle

• Own the design, documentation, and rollout of our new Resell Program, including rules of engagement (ROE), the bookings guide, and the product & pricing book.

• Own the ongoing maintenance and updates of our Partner Program Guide, ensuring it stays current, accurate, and easy for partners and internal teams to reference.

• Build and maintain the on-ramp playbook: a structured sequence of activities, resources, and milestones that takes a newly signed partner from agreement execution to certification completion.

• Lead the design and documentation of global process standards across key partner lifecycle domains, including partner onboarding, partner lead management, deal registration, co-sell motions, attribution, incentive management, and partner renewals.

• Design strategic programs that advance our broader partner strategy, from concept through documentation and launch.

• Drive the operational and Partner Portal design work needed to support the Resell Program and broader partner programs, mapping workflows, removing friction, and improving the end-to-end partner experience.

• Help shape and operationalize unified subscription management across the partner ecosystem, working cross-functionally to drive the underlying process and systems changes.

• Collaborate closely with Partner Operations and Systems teams (e.g., Partner Portal, Salesforce) to ensure programs are supported by scalable, well-maintained tooling.

• Serve as a trusted, high-energy point of contact for partners, building strong personal relationships, representing the voice of the partner internally, and attending partner events and conferences.

Operating Rhythm & Governance

• Establish and run the operating rhythm for the Partner organization, including integrated planning cycles, governance forums, and a single source of truth across partner initiatives.

• Establish program management rigor across partner initiatives, including goals, milestones, dependencies, decision points, risk tracking, and executive readouts.

• Establish governance structures and drive consistent global adoption of standardized partner processes across the matrixed organization.

• Drive continuous improvement by identifying process breakdowns, diagnosing root causes, and simplifying how the Partner organization operates.

• Manage and grow our partner program governance forums, including the Strategic Partner Advisory Council, from agenda-setting through follow-through on action items.

• Help define and refine scalable operating models across partner-led motions, and translate strategic initiatives into clear process, policy, and system requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years of experience in partner programs, channel operations, or partner management, with a track record of designing and running programs, not just supporting them.

• Demonstrated experience building or significantly evolving a resell, reseller, or similar partner transaction program, including ROE, pricing, and bookings governance.

• Strong program and project management skills, comfortable owning goals, milestones, dependencies, risk tracking, and executive-level readouts across multiple concurrent initiatives.

• Strong track record of building genuine, trusted relationships with external partners; known for being someone partners want to work with.

• Comfortable operating with ambiguity, defining new processes, and adapting quickly as priorities shift.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate program mechanics into clear documentation and partner-facing materials.

• High energy, detail-oriented, and willing to travel for partner events, advisory councils, and conferences.

• Strong interpersonal, collaboration, and influencing skills, with experience aligning stakeholders across Sales, Legal, Finance, and Operations.

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

• Experience designing or operating a Partner/Reseller Advisory Council or similar strategic partner governance body.

• Experience with partner or subscription management models, including unified or consolidated subscription management initiatives.

• Strong working knowledge of Salesforce and Partner Relationship Management (PRM) or partner portal platforms.

• AI-first mindset, with interest in using AI tools to improve program design, documentation, and operations.

• Experience in the software/SaaS industry; familiarity with Drupal, DXP, or the broader digital experience platform space is a plus.

We are an organization that embraces innovation and the potential of AI to enhance our processes and improve our work. We are always looking for individuals who are open to learning new technologies and collaborating with AI tools to achieve our goals.

Acquia is proud to provide best-in-class benefits to help our employees and their families maintain a healthy body and mind. Core Benefits include: competitive healthcare coverage, wellness programs, take it when you need it time off, parental leave, recognition programs, and much more! 

Final compensation will be commensurate with your experience and will be determined by a variety of factors, including city of residence, relevant skillset, and job-related knowledge. This role is also eligible for variable compensation.

Acquia is an equal opportunity (EEO) employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veterans status or any other protected status or characteristic under federal, state or local law unrelated to the ability to perform the job.
Pay Range
$135,000—$150,000 USD

title: Sr. Account Strategist, Client Growth
description:
Title: Sr. Account Strategist, Client Growth

URL Source: https://br8kthru.bamboohr.com/careers/49

Markdown Content:
### Sr. Account Strategist, Client Growth

Account Services - Minneapolis, Minnesota (Hybrid)

* * *

Department: Account Strategy | Reports To: CEO | Type: Full-Time

About the Role

Br8kthru is looking for an Account Strategist who can operate as a trusted advisor, client thought partner, and commercial leader within our account team. This role owns a portfolio of client relationships and is accountable for retention, account health, and thoughtful revenue growth.

The right person brings a strong mix of digital marketing fluency, business acumen, curiosity, and competitive drive. They do not wait for clients to ask what is next — they identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, shape recommendations, and help turn smart ideas into scoped, paid work. This is not pressure-based sales. It is proactive client leadership.

What You'll Own

This role is accountable for turning client trust into strategic momentum. You will be expected to understand each client’s business, anticipate needs, identify growth opportunities, and help Br8kthru bring the right recommendations forward at the right time.

Revenue & Growth

*   Manage and grow a portfolio of client accounts, with mature portfolio responsibility expected to reach $750K+ in annual billable revenue
*   Support portfolio-level revenue growth through renewals, strategic expansion opportunities, pilots, retainers, SOWs, and change orders
*   Identify, initiate, and advance expansion opportunities — growth conversations should be strategist-led, not only client-initiated
*   Maintain an active pipeline of strategic recommendations and qualified account opportunities across your portfolio
*   Protect scope and profitability by identifying when new requests require revised priorities, additional budget, or a new SOW
*   Partner with leadership and delivery teams to turn client needs into clear recommendations, next steps, and paid work

Retention & Account Health

*   Retain 85–100% of your client portfolio year-over-year
*   Maintain a monthly account health score of 90%+ across satisfaction and communication dimensions
*   Build retention through trusted advisory relationships and proactive strategy — not accommodation or avoidance

Strategy & Proactivity

*   Develop and maintain a current strategic roadmap or account plan for every client in your portfolio
*   Use curiosity and business context to uncover the deeper problem behind the request
*   Help clients make better decisions by connecting digital marketing recommendations to business priorities
*   Bring ideas, trends, insights, and recommendations to clients before they ask — anticipating needs rather than reacting to them
*   Lead strategic conversations around opportunity, scope, budget, and performance with empathy and confidence
*   Achieve meaningful client adoption of your strategic recommendations

Collaboration & Handoff Quality

*   Partner closely with Client Experience Managers (CEMs) to ensure seamless project execution
*   Deliver complete, high-quality briefs, SOWs, and kickoff prep that meet the Br8kthru MSS standard
*   Contribute to team knowledge by sharing new marketing trends and insights monthly

What Success Looks Like

In this role, performance is evaluated across three dimensions. The behaviors and relationships that produce results matter as much as the results themselves.

1.   Outcomes (reviewed monthly):

Revenue targets met, retention held, account health scores strong.
2.   Strategic Behaviors (reviewed monthly and quarterly):

Growth conversations initiated, roadmaps maintained, scope protected, proactive recommendations delivered.
3.   Relationship Depth (reviewed quarterly and biannually): Clients are bringing you into bigger decisions. They describe you as someone who challenges and leads them.

Who You Are

*   A competitive, proactive account leader who wants to grow meaningful client relationships, not simply maintain them
*   A curious thinker who asks strong questions, digs into the client’s business, and looks for the why behind the work
*   A credible client thought partner with the digital marketing fluency and business acumen to challenge assumptions and recommend smarter paths forward
*   Entrepreneurial by nature — you take ownership, see whitespace, and create momentum without waiting for perfect instructions
*   Comfortable hearing no, but not easily stopped by it; you know how to reframe, ask better questions, and keep the conversation moving constructively
*   Commercially minded and strategic; you understand how marketing investment connects to business outcomes, revenue, retention, and growth
*   Equally effective at building relationships and driving accountability
*   Someone who sees growth conversations as strategic acts of service, not pressure
*   Collaborative internally and credible externally

What This Role Is Not

*   This is not a passive account management role, a project coordination role, or a purely relationship-maintenance role.
*   You will not be expected to use pressure-based sales tactics. But you will be expected to identify client needs, challenge assumptions, recommend next steps, and help turn strategic opportunities into paid work.
*   This role is for someone who wants to lead clients, not simply respond to them.

Qualifications

*   4+ years of experience in account strategy, client growth, account management, client success, or consultative B2B sales — ideally in a marketing services, agency, consulting, martech, SaaS, or B2B environment
*   Demonstrated track record of growing and retaining client accounts
*   Experience initiating and leading revenue-generating conversations with senior stakeholders
*   Strong business acumen and ability to connect marketing activity to client goals, revenue, retention, and growth
*   Strong written and verbal communication skills
*   Familiarity with CRM tools (Pipedrive experience a plus)
*   Strong understanding of digital marketing disciplines and how they work together

Compensation & Structure

This is a full-time client growth role with a base salary plus performance-based compensation tied to portfolio revenue growth, retention, and account health outcomes. Specific compensation details will be shared during the interview process.

title: Partner Program & Operations Manager
description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is disrupting the workforce development industry, leveraging an AI-powered marketplace of more than 60,000 skills courses, complemented by assessments, content authoring, curation, personalized learning pathways, and virtual coaching. Learning is delivered seamlessly through existing enterprise systems and in the flow of work. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.

Learn more: www.opensesame.com/about

About the Team

The Partnerships team is responsible for the growth and the health of OpenSesame's global partner ecosystem. We work across technology, channel, referral, reseller, marketplace, and strategic alliances to expand reach of our joint solutions and deliver exceptional experiences for our partners and their customers.

The Partner Program & Operations Manager designs the systems that scale partner-led growth for OpenSesame. From partner programs and strategic planning to operational processes, enablement, automation, and cross-functional initiatives, the team builds the infrastructure that enables our indirect business to thrive.

About the Role

OpenSesame is seeking a strategic, systems-minded, and highly collaborative Partner Program & Operations Manager to design, evolve, and evolve the operating model behind our global partner ecosystem.

Rather than managing partner relationships directly, this role owns the programs, planning frameworks, governance, operational processes, and strategic initiatives that enable those relationships to succeed. You'll translate business strategy into scalable execution by partnering across Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Finance, Business Systems, and Partnerships.

This role is ideal for someone with a proven track record of building and scaling programs in SaaS, simplifying complex business processes, leading cross-functional initiatives, and leveraging automation and AI to drive operational excellence and improve organizational effectiveness.

What You'll Do

Own the Partner Program

• Own and evolve the OpenSesame Partner Program, including structure benefits, incentives, onboarding, lifecycle management, documentation, communications, and governance.

• Continuously improve the partner experience while ensuring the program remains scalable and aligned with business priorities.

Lead Strategic Planning & Programs

• Own annual and quarterly partner planning cycles, executive planning materials, and strategic planning frameworks.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives that strengthen the partner ecosystem, improve operational efficiency, enhance the partner experience, and support partner-led revenue growth.

• Develop roadmaps and operating rhythms that align partner initiatives with company OKRs and measurable business outcomes.

Build Scalable Partner Operations

• Design and optimize operational processes across onboarding, activation, referrals, co-sell, OEM, partner lifecycle management, and governance.

• Standardize documentation, templates, and operating procedures that improve consistency while reducing operational complexity.

• Identify opportunities to automate workflows and improve team productivity

• Manage, evolve and enable team on specific GTM and Partner software such as Salesforce, Euler, Crossbeam, Gong, etc.

Drive Performance & Business Insights

• Define partner performance metrics and reporting frameworks, including sourced and influenced revenue, partner activation, partner health, operational KPIs, and program adoption.

• Partner with Revenue Operations and Business Systems to develop dashboards, executive reporting, Board decks and actionable business insights.

• Translate performance data into recommendations that improve partner outcomes and support strategic decision-making.

Strengthen Partner Enablement

• Partner with GTM Enablement to improve partner onboarding, certification, communications, co-sell readiness, and partner activation and engagement.

• Ensure partner-facing resources and internal enablement evolve alongside the Partner Program.

Lead Operational Excellence

• Manage and develop a Partner Program Associate and interns

• Support recruiting and onboarding of new Partner team members.

• Foster a culture of continuous improvement through documentation, repeatable processes, automation, and AI-enabled workflows.

• Serve as a trusted operational partner across the organization, improving how teams work together to support partner-led growth.

Key Performance Objectives

Within 30 Days: Learn & Assess

Build a strong understanding of OpenSesame's partner ecosystem, operating model, and strategic priorities while establishing trusted relationships across the business.

Success looks like:

• Develop a deep understanding of the Partner Program, GTM motions, partner lifecycle, and operating model.

• Build relationships with key stakeholders across Partners, Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Business Systems.

• Assess current partner planning, onboarding, enablement, reporting, governance, and operational processes.

• Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve the partner experience, and increase operational efficiency.

• Align with leadership on priorities, success measures, and long-term objectives.

Within 60 Days: Own & Improve

Begin leading key operational initiatives while delivering measurable improvements to the partner operating model.

Success looks like:

• Assume ownership of the Partner Program operating model and governance.

• Lead strategic initiatives by coordinating stakeholders, communications, timelines, and execution.

• Deliver early improvements to partner planning, onboarding, enablement, or operational workflows.

• Partner with Revenue Operations and Business Systems to evaluate reporting, dashboards, and partner health metrics.

• Identify and prioritize AI and automation opportunities that improve scalability and reduce manual work.

• Begin coaching and developing the Partner Program Associate.

Within 90 Days: Deliver & Scale

Operate as the strategic owner of the Partner Program while establishing a roadmap for continued growth and optimization.

Success looks like:

• Fully own the Partner Program operating model and cross-functional initiatives.

• Deliver measurable improvements to partner planning, operational processes, reporting, governance, or enablement.

• Launch or advance AI and automation initiatives that improve productivity across the Partnerships organization.

• Establish executive-ready reporting that provides visibility into partner activation, program adoption, operational KPIs, and business impact.

• Build a prioritized roadmap for the continued evolution of the Partner Program and partner operating model.

• Be recognized as a trusted operational leader and strategic partner across the business.

Within 6–12 Months: Optimize & Lead

Continue evolving OpenSesame's partner operating model into a scalable, best-in-class foundation for partner-led growth.

Success looks like:

• Continuously improve the Partner Program to support changing business needs and long-term growth.

• Successfully deliver strategic initiatives that improve partner activation, engagement, and partner-led revenue.

• Increase automation while reducing operational complexity across the partner lifecycle.

• Mature annual planning, Quarterly Business Reviews, executive reporting, and governance into repeatable operating rhythms.

• Expand AI-enabled workflows that improve productivity and operational efficiency across the Partnerships organization.

• Enable Strategic Partner Managers to spend more time growing partner relationships and less time navigating operational processes.

What Success Looks Like

• The Partner Program is simple, scalable, and aligned with business strategy.

• Strategic initiatives are successfully launched, broadly adopted across the business, and establish scalable frameworks that can be leveraged for future initiatives.

• Partner planning, onboarding, enablement, and governance operate through repeatable, well-defined processes.

• Leadership has trusted visibility into partner performance, program adoption, operational KPIs, and business impact.

• AI and automation meaningfully reduce manual work while improving operational efficiency.

• Strategic Partner Managers spend more time growing partner relationships and less time managing operational work.

• The Partnerships organization has a trusted operational leader responsible for continuously improving how partner-led growth scales.

Location: This is a remote role open to candidates based in the United States. OpenSesame is a remote-first company, and with some travel required

Compensation: The base salary for this position typically ranges from $135,000 -$148,000 USD annually, depending on experience. This role is also eligible for a bonus. At OpenSesame, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to employees upon hire, including professional development, ISOs, health insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off. 

Performance Driven: We're looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, and we're highly selective about who we hire. We don't focus on typical job requirements, instead, we're interested in specific examples from your past experiences.

Benefits: Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO, 401(k) matching, incentive stock options, volunteer time off, Employee Resource Groups, and a generous professional development program with dedicated annual time off for learning and growth.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

Pay Transparency: At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation practices to align with our values and goals. We provide competitive and fair compensation to our employees based on their skills, experience, and performance.

CPRA (California Candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

We Care About Your Security: We’ve been made aware of a phishing scam involving individuals impersonating OpenSesame recruiters. All legitimate communication from our team will come from @opensesame.com email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message, please contact us directly at careers@opensesame.com. Your security matters to us, thank you for staying vigilant.

title: Account Manager
description:
ABOUT ALEPH

Aleph is an AI-native platform for Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), an established software category with a multi-billion market but no clear winner. We’re trying to solve a problem many finance teams are super familiar with: data scattered across a million systems, endless spreadsheets and way too much time spent getting numbers to line up instead of actually using them to make decisions.

Aleph was founded by Albert Gozzi and Santiago Perez De Rosso, two technical founders with backgrounds from Stanford and MIT and experience working at top-tier companies such as Google, Microsoft and Bain & Company. We’re backed by top VCs (Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, YC, Picus Capital), and work with customers like Webflow, Notion, Zapier, Y Combinator and many others.

We are hiring remotely across the Americas (United States, Canada, LATAM).

 What we're looking for

This is Aleph's first Account Manager hire. You'll own the revenue side of our customer relationships -renewals, expansions, upsells- working directly with finance teams who hold vendors to a high standard and can tell the difference between a good pitch and genuine expertise.

You're not walking into a blank slate. We have better-than-benchmark churn and NDR, a CS team that runs deep implementations, and customers who are genuinely happy with the product. What we're missing is someone to formalize the expansion motion, build it into a repeatable playbook, and own it going forward.

That means showing up credibly on two fronts: you can hold a commercial conversation with a CFO, and you can sit in a product implementation review and actually follow along.

This is a remote role open to candidates based anywhere in the US or Canada.

‍ What you'll be doing

 - Own the end-to-end renewal process for a portfolio of accounts

 - Formalize our expansion playbook and scale it -- identify where growth potential lives, design the motion, execute it yourself

 - Partner with CSMs on account strategy; you bring the commercial angle, they bring the implementation depth

 - Engage directly with finance teams and economic buyers -- understand their workflows, speak their language, and connect Aleph's value to outcomes they actually care about

 - Run pricing conversations and negotiate renewals and expansions with confidence

 - Develop enough product fluency to discuss implementation details credibly and handle technical questions without flinching

 - Track account health signals: usage trends, AI adoption, seat utilization, QBR context

 - Flag at-risk accounts early and work with CSMs and leadership on save strategies

 What you bring

 - Strong analytical foundations -- finance, consulting, engineering, product etc.; whatever the path, you can work with complex data, build a tight argument, and earn trust with quantitative buyers

 - You've carried a quota, hit it, and know how to close

 - You're high slope -- you pick things up fast, take on more than your role requires, and have a track record of outgrowing wherever you've been

 - You can hold your own in a CFO or FP&A conversation as someone who genuinely understands how finance teams think, not as a vendor running through a deck

Any of the following would be a plus:

 - High-rigor background (consulting, IB, PE) with a deliberate move into go-to-market

 - Experience in a customer-facing B2B SaaS role

 - Time spent directly on a finance team at a software company

 - FP&A experience specifically -- you know what Aleph's customers do every day because you've done it

While this is a remote-first opportunity, we're focusing on candidates within the Americas to better align with our working hours as a team.

Aleph is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Aleph makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

title: Lead Account Manager
description:
Who We Are:

Interra Health is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming how providers and patients navigate the prescription journey. Formed through the merger of DoseSpot, Arrive Health, and pVerify, Interra Health delivers trusted eligibility, real-time coverage and pricing insights, prescribing tools, and pharmacy transparency at the point of care—helping providers make informed decisions and patients access the right medications with greater clarity and affordability. Backed by strong market momentum and a bold vision for the future of connected care, Interra Health offers the chance to join an innovative, mission-driven team working at the intersection of software and healthcare to reduce friction, improve access, and make the healthcare experience better for everyone.

The Role:

The Lead Account Manager is a strategic, customer-facing player-coach responsible for managing a portfolio of high-value accounts while helping build a more consistent and scalable account management function across Interra Health. This role may support either DoseSpot or pVerify based on business need and is expected to evolve as the company continues moving toward a unified, segment-based account management model. The role reports to the Head of Account Management and partners closely with Sales, Product, Support, Marketing, and Operations to improve retention, strengthen executive relationships, and create clearer visibility into customer health, risk, adoption, and growth opportunities across the segment.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Own a portfolio of high-value accounts with full accountability for retention, growth, and executive relationship management — including business reviews, renewal planning, and C-suite engagement.

 - Coach Account Managers and Senior Account Managers on customer planning, risk mitigation, stakeholder mapping, and growth strategy.

 - Own proactive outreach to the segment book when new products or features roll out — not waiting for clients to discover them; field objections, clear escalation blockers, track adoption, and flag at-risk accounts to the Head of Account Management.

 - Lead joint planning conversations with customers to uncover growth opportunities and deepen platform adoption.

 - Build and maintain segment-level reporting on customer health, renewal risk, adoption trends, expansion opportunities, and account-level goals — including ARR growth, usage trends, and health scores — for use in executive communications.

 - Surface friction points — product gaps, support patterns, onboarding challenges — in a data-informed way that drives action across the business.

 - Serve as the primary voice of the customer for the segment, contributing structured insights to roadmap, packaging, and go-to-market decisions.

 - Partner with the Head of Account Management to develop consistent AM processes, playbooks, forecasting practices, and operating rhythms.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Product, Support, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to advocate for customer needs and manage complex escalations.

 - Support the transition from product-based to segment-based account management, helping shape structure and process along the way.

AI Expectations:

Leverage AI-enabled tools to improve customer health monitoring, streamline reporting workflows, surface renewal risk earlier, and increase the speed and quality of insights delivered to internal stakeholders and customers. Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT or Claude is a plus; candidates who use AI thoughtfully to improve execution, prioritization, and decision-making will be well positioned for success in this role.

What You’ll Bring:

Degree & Years of Experience:

Typically requires 7+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or a similar post-sale commercial role, along with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Knowledge & Application:

Brings deep knowledge of account management practices, customer health methodologies, and SaaS commercial models, ideally in healthcare technology. Operates independently, prioritizes effectively across a complex portfolio, and exercises sound judgment in managing renewals, customer risk, and growth opportunities.

Complexity & Problem Solving:

Navigates complex, multi-stakeholder customer situations involving renewal risk, product limitations, organizational change, or competitive pressure. Identifies patterns across accounts and translates them into scalable solutions, process improvements, and escalation priorities. Creates practical frameworks and reporting approaches where they do not yet exist.

Collaboration & Interaction:

Works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Support, Marketing, Operations, and executive leadership. Coaches others while owning a strategic book of business and serves as a key conduit between the field and leadership by translating customer and segment signals into actionable recommendations.

Working Conditions & Environment:

Fully remote role within the United States

Periodic travel (approximately 15-25%) for customer meetings, team events, and industry conferences

Operates in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, PE-backed SaaS environment

Requires strong cross-functional collaboration across Product, Sales, Support, and Executive Leadership

Ability to manage a complex portfolio of accounts and shifting organizational priorities simultaneously

Success in this role requires strong asynchronous communication, thoughtful prioritization, and comfort operating in a remote-first environment

Benefits & Perks:

Competitive compensation

Remote-first

Work from anywhere in US. We also provide a one-time home office stipend to set up your workspace, plus a monthly Wi-Fi reimbursement.

Flexible work
Flexible scheduling and core collaboration hours (10:00 AM – 3:00 PM ET), giving you space for both deep work and real life.

 Company-wide offsite
We invest in connection—join us for an annual offsite to collaborate, build relationships, and have some fun together.

Time off that you’re expected to use
Flexible PTO designed for real recharge, plus 17 company holidays, paid sick leave, and paid parental leave.

Comprehensive health coverage
Choose from multiple medical plan options with significant company premium contributions, along with dental (including orthodontia) and vision coverage for you and your family.
Includes company contributions to HSA/FSA accounts (based on plan selection).

Financial wellness
401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future.

Interra Health is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Program Manager, Alliances & Channels
description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups— use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
The Alliances and Channels (A&C) team is responsible for building a vibrant ecosystem of partners that accelerates our mission. Within A&C, the Programs team drives partner success and ecosystem growth at scale through programs, incentives, enablement, and operational rigor.

The Platform Co-sell Initiative enables SaaS platforms to co-sell Stripe alongside their enterprise and commercial customers globally. The program spans platform qualification and readiness, direct sales enablement, commercial model development, and go-to-market framework design across AMER, EMEA, and APAC—and operates at the center of A&C's strategy for scaling partner-sourced revenue.

What you’ll do
You will own the day-to-day operation of the Platform Co-sell Initiative—a high-visibility, cross-functional program that runs to senior sales and partnerships leadership—building the operating system that allows Stripe's partner managers, channel sales, and direct sales teams to co-sell at scale. You will run the platform qualification funnel, own program reporting, manage the cadences that keep sales and partner teams aligned, and build the commercial frameworks that govern how the program grows.

This role spans program management, operations, and analytics. It's for someone equally comfortable shipping a dashboard, running a quarterly business review, and drafting a framework for how to tier a partner portfolio—and who raises the quality bar without needing a big team.

Responsibilities

• Own the A&C co-sell program end-to-end: define what co-sell readiness means across partner types, maintain the standards that govern which partners enter the motion and how, and serve as the connective tissue between partner teams and the direct sales organization

• Own the platform qualification funnel from nomination through co-sell readiness and activation, including intake standards, progress tracking, partner health monitoring, and portal operations

• Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting for program health and outcomes (platform activation, co-sell pipeline, deal conversion, incentives throughput); define metrics and documentation so reporting is trusted and reusable

• Develop seller-facing reporting experiences that make partner signals actionable (account views with signal type, recency, and deal stage)

• Partner with GTM Ops and data owners to improve data availability and attribution; identify gaps and drive pragmatic fixes

• Own the operating interface with the sales development representatives that support partners: intake standards, routing rules, play briefs, QA loop, and weekly/monthly performance readouts tied to SLAs and pipeline outcomes

• Operationalize and track the effectiveness of partner-ready sales plays end-to-end (inputs, workflows, scorecards, iteration loop) and drive a consistent cadence to monitor and improve execution

• Build the frameworks that govern how the program scales: platform engagement tiers, low-touch model, and capacity planning

• Proactively identify at-risk program work and step in to unblock delivery when timelines or data quality are at risk

Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

title: Partner Success Manager
description:
ABOUT CHECK

Payroll is broken. Come fix it alongside a team that’s as passionate as you are!

At Check, we’re not just building our own business — we’re building payroll businesses together with every one of our partners. As the inventors of embedded payroll, we’re redefining how people get paid and making it easier for payroll businesses to launch, grow, and thrive.

On our team you'll use creative problem-solving, critical thinking, and grit to simplify the complexity of payroll for thousands of employers of every size, across all industries. We ignore conventional role boundaries in favor of the unique strengths and values each builder brings to our mission: make paying people simple.

 - Check out the full story https://www.generalist.com/briefing/check

 - Tune in https://open.spotify.com/episode/6qJMGPkqJVxEFPJRvnc9ml?si=6ea8c2b634374b18

Check is far more than just API infrastructure. We’re a springboard for building and scaling payroll businesses.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Check is looking for it's next Partner Success Manager. This is a high visibility and strategic role where you'll serve as General Manager for a portfolio of 5-10 high priority partners. You’ll manage these partners by establishing and maintaining a communication cadence with your portfolio, and provide proactive reporting on their status internally.

We expect our team to roll up their sleeves and execute with a high degree of autonomy, sharing information and knowledge early and often with peers and stakeholders. You will work closely with cross-functional internal and external teams, including Sales, R&D, Marketing, Enablement, Product and others. Together, you'll identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and execute on targets with determination and precision.

Candidates ideal for this role are tenacious, goal-oriented, and experienced with building detailed strategic plans with Partners/customers. You must have a knack for ruthless prioritization, and comfort operating in technical and commercially complex environments.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Earn the trust of our Partners and build in-depth relationships by maintaining a complete understanding of their business goals and objectives across various stakeholders

 - Consult on our Partners’ payroll business by investigating the root cause of blockers, outlining and selling Partners on the appropriate strategies to unblock inefficiencies and revenue, and creating strategic execution plans while acting as a trusted advisor to ensure every Partner is leveraging the full value of Check

 - Execute all phases of the post-sales Partner lifecycle, including launch, milestone setting and renewal negotiations

 - Outline mutual success metrics/KPIs with our Partners that align their and Check’s revenue/growth goals

 - Develop, execute, and maintain a communication cadence with your portfolio of Partners

 - Inform cross-functional counterparts on focus areas relative to Partner needs and pain points

 - Partner with cross-functional teams to build appropriate communication plans including but not limited to releases, roadmap updates, compliance updates, and incident management

 - Introduce and implement new products and features to your Partners, evaluate their success, and navigate feedback channels with them and Check’s Product team

MANY BACKGROUNDS COULD FIT THIS ROLE, BUT IDEAL CANDIDATES WILL HAVE MOST OR ALL OF THE FOLLOWING:

 - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, in a related field

 - 5+ years of relevant work experience, including:
 
 - Experience in the SaaS space - experience in the fintech or payroll space a plus
 
 - Strategic growth or consulting experience
 
 - Post-sales partner/account management or existing account growth experience
 
 - Demonstrated success owning a portfolio of customer or partner relationships with complex technical/product needs

 - Familiarity with AI tools and curiosity about how they can improve partner workflows

 - Empathy and genuine care for partners - you view their success as your own

 - You run toward hard problems, prioritize truth over consensus, and are energized by operating in technically and commercially complex environments

 - Ability to navigate the political landscape of our enterprise partner organizations, and to develop and expand meaningful relationships

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills — including the ability to communicate complex ideas concisely in live partner calls, escalation conversations, and executive settings

 - Flexibility, ability to adapt and learn quickly, and to capably balance multiple priorities and projects (internally and externally) in a fast-paced environment

 - Fluency or familiarity with Check’s primary software applications i.e. Zendesk, Google Workspace, Notion, etc.

 - Strong documentation muscle - you default to written record as a regular practice and maintain clean notes in tools like CRMs

 - Enthusiasm for planning, adjusting, executing, winning, and celebrating as a team

 - Ability to travel regularly (est. no more than 20%), including to Check’s annual company retreat in Mexico each spring

TRAVEL & OFFICE POLICY

The Check team is distributed across the US. Roles can be remote, hybrid, or based in one of our offices in New York City or San Francisco. We offer ample opportunities and encourage employees to attend team offsites, events, and hackathons throughout year. All Checketeers gather in the spring for our annual 3-day company retreat.

For our in-office and hybrid employees, our offices are open all week. We provide meals on Tuesdays and Thursdays and there are regular happy hours, game nights, and other in-person events.

Remote work at Check requires the ability to perform all responsibilities without distraction or disruption, while maintaining quality, effective communication, and productivity.

--

Check is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, provided they are consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Check is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

Check participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information from all new employees to confirm that they are authorized to work in the U.S. Check does not use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

title: Director of Product Partnerships
description:
GC AI https://gc.ai/ is the fastest-growing and most trusted legal AI platform for in-house legal teams. We're building the future of legal work, and we're doing it fast. You'll join at a pivotal moment—when decisions matter, impact is immediate, and the runway to shape your career is wide open. We’re a high-performing team where you'll have real ownership and influence from day one.

More than 1,800 companies use GC AI to drive their business forward, including 150+ public companies, 25+ unicorns, and brands such as News Corp, Miro, Bass Pro Shops, Snyk, Skims, Liquid Death, Vercel, Zscaler, and TIME.

We've 10x'd revenue in 12 months, raised a $60 million Series B ($555 million valuation) https://gc.ai/blog/gc-ai-raises-60-million-series-b-to-give-every-company-a-legal-advantage, and are growing faster than ever. We are backed by incredible investors, including Scale Venture Partners, Northzone, Sound Ventures, and Guillermo Rauch, CEO of Vercel.

If you thrive when the stakes are high and the path isn't paved, you'll love it here. Our six guiding principles are: 1% better every day, customer obsession, ship today, find a way, care deeply, and own it completely. Come shape the future of legal work with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Director of Partnerships to help build and lead GC AI’s partner engine, turning strategic relationships into a scalable, revenue-generating growth channel at a pivotal moment for the company. You will have high visibility across the organization and the autonomy to define and execute our partnership strategy, owning end-to-end ecosystem development in the legal tech and enterprise software space.

You will be a strategic builder and operator, responsible for mapping the in-house legal ecosystem, prioritizing high-leverage partner types (workflow integrations, channel/reseller programs, trusted advisors, and strategic alliances), activating key relationships, and creating repeatable motions that drive qualified pipeline, adoption, and ARR with low CAC.

We’re looking for a proven strategic partnerships leader who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and has deep expertise in enterprise B2B SaaS sales, ideally in legal tech or AI-driven markets. You should have a track record of driving multimillion-dollar partnerships, and aligning with technical and non-technical cross-functional teams to deliver measurable results.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Define & Execute Partner Strategy: Along with the VP of Partnerships, you'll own GC AI’s end-to-end partner engine, map the legal tech ecosystem, prioritize high-leverage partner types (channel, integrations, strategic alliances), and build repeatable motions that drive scalable ARR with low CAC.

 - Build Channel & Revenue Partnerships: Launch and scale referral, reseller, and managed service programs from zero; source/onboard partners design incentives, co-selling frameworks, and attribution to generate qualified pipeline and predictable revenue.

 - Develop VC & High-Influence Referrals: Manage bespoke VC-led referral channels with warm intros, qualification guardrails, white-glove handoffs, and quality-focused metrics (conversion, time-to-value, repeat referrals) to protect trust and credibility.

 - Drive Ecosystem & Integration Partnerships: Identify and launch strategic tech integrations that embed GC AI into legal workflows; collaborate with Product/Engineering to prioritize, scope, and deliver features that boost retention and position GC AI as core infrastructure.

 - Enable Partners & Operations: In partnerships with Sales Enablement, Revenue Operations and Marketing, create onboarding, certification, enablement, co-marketing, and performance tracking systems; establish KPIs (pipeline influence, ROI, partner-sourced revenue) and maintain proactive relationships as the single point of accountability.

 - Provide Market Intelligence: Monitor legal tech, AI, and enterprise trends; represent GC AI in ecosystems/events; feed insights to Product, Sales, Marketing, and leadership to shape roadmap, positioning, and GTM.

 - Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Revenue Operations, Finance, and the exec team to align on strategy, attribution, and ecosystem plays that reduce adoption friction and accelerate growth.

WHAT YOU’VE DONE

 - 7+ years in partnerships, business development, or channel roles in B2B SaaS, with at least 3+ years leading partner programs or teams in high-growth environments.

 - Proven success building and scaling partner motions (channel/revenue, integrations, strategic alliances) that deliver measurable revenue, pipeline, and ecosystem impact.

 - Track record sourcing, negotiating, onboarding, and managing partners (resellers, ISVs, VCs, advisors) to drive qualified leads, adoption, and retention.

 - Experience designing incentive structures, enablement programs, attribution models, and performance reporting to create predictable, data-driven partner channels.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Product, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Finance, and leadership to align partnerships with broader GTM goals.

 - Demonstrated ability to map ecosystems, prioritize opportunities based on ROI/leverage, and turn "partner interest" into repeatable revenue.

 - Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills, with a history of engaging senior stakeholders (e.g., GCs/CLOs, VC partners, execs) in complex deals.

 - Analytical mindset with expertise in tracking KPIs (e.g., partner-influenced revenue, conversion rates, ROI) and using data to optimize programs.

 - Self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous startup settings while balancing strategic vision with tactical execution.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in legal tech, AI-driven tools, or selling to in-house legal teams (GC/CLO/legal ops).

 - Familiarity with SaaS partner economics, co-sell motions, PRM tools, or methodologies for measuring partner ROI.

 - Background in high-trust channels like VC referrals or trusted advisor networks.

 - Experience representing companies in industry events/communities to build relationships early.

A NOTE ON PACE

We’re building something new in a once-in-a-generation shift in technology and the legal industry, so we move at a relentless pace. We expect urgency, ownership, and good judgment even when things aren’t perfectly clear. If you need structure and consensus to do your best work, this isn’t the right place for you. If you thrive in ambiguity and growth, work with intensity, and want real responsibility, keep reading. We’re excited to meet you.

HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

GC AI is a distributed company with team members across North America, and soon Europe. We believe that because our business is AI, human connection matters more, not less. We invest in bringing people together through our hub model: regular coworking sessions, customer dinners, team and company offsites. If you’re in a location without an office, expect up to 10% travel (and more for customer-facing roles).

Team members in the San Francisco Bay Area and Provo, UT (within 50 miles of the office) work together on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. As we grow, we plan to establish permanent offices in more hub cities, and we will look to our team members to help build that in-person culture. We currently hire across the United States and Canada.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYMENT

GC AI is an equal opportunity employer that supports workplace diversity and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity/expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other protected class. GC AI is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. #LI-GCAI

FRAUD NOTICE TO GC AI APPLICANTS

To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that GC AI only accepts job applications through our official careers page at https://gc.ai/careers and through sponsored jobs on LinkedIn. All legitimate communication from our team regarding job opportunities will come from a GC AI team member with a @gc.ai http://gc.ai or @getgc.ai http://getgc.ai email address.

GC AI will never:

 - Conduct interviews over email, chat platforms, or messaging apps
