title: Partnership Manager
description:
Role Overview
The Partnership Manager drives growth and engagement across a portfolio of partners within the health and life sciences ecosystem. This role focuses on building and managing a strong sales pipeline through research, outreach, and consultative sales conversations.

Responsibilities include developing new partnerships, strengthening existing relationships, and achieving annual revenue targets. The role leverages CRM tools and data insights to identify opportunities, guide organizations toward membership or alternative engagement options, and support strategic initiatives.
This position requires a relationship-driven, self-motivated professional who is comfortable engaging executive-level stakeholders and contributing to a collaborative team environment. Digital sales and sponsorships provide additional solutions for organizations that are not a fit for membership.

Position Structure: The Partnership Manager role requires strategic vision, analytical acumen, and a collaborative approach to effectively align partnership and data-driven goals. The Partnership Manager will also be a functional partner to other teams, supporting membership. This position reports to the Vice President of Partnerships.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:
Manage relationships with key partners within the Medical Alley health ecosystem, overseeing and managing an assigned portfolio of partners, which would include the following responsibilities:
• Build a Partner Pipeline. Managing a new partner pipeline by identifying new potential partners that fit within the strategic direction of Medical Alley and actively converting contacts to paying partners through proactive outreach, introductions, connections, and meetings to educate on benefits and the value proposition.
• Negotiate Terms. Negotiate agreements with partners to manage expectations and commitments to align with internal and external best practices.
• Renewal Process. Manage yearly renewal of partner memberships, responsible for managing the process and reporting.
• Partner Satisfaction. Responsible for partners satisfaction through day-to-day direct contact and yearly surveys. Solicit feedback, analyze information, and recommend and implement improvements as appropriate.
• Strategizing. Develop Strategies to grow and optimize partnerships and enhance the company’s market presence.
• Ensuring Success. Ensuring the successful engagement and governance of partnerships. Tracking and measuring year over year retention, growth, conversion, and “customer” satisfaction rates Personal success includes performance measures against goals and benchmarks in these categories.
• Develop initiatives to engage leaders from partner organizations for networking and professional development opportunities.
• Present and manage key engagement and sponsorship opportunities across the Medical Alley community.
• Represent Medical Alley at events and meetings, fostering relationships within the healthcare community.
• Manage day-to-day administrative tasks related to membership, including new member onboarding, data entry, and generating engagement reports.

Qualifications/Requirements
• Strong ability to build relationships across C-suite organizational levels.
• Strong sales skills with proven sales record and understanding of sales funnels and probability reporting.
• 4+ years of customer relations experience with a focus on retention
• Professional presence with outstanding verbal and written communication skills o Strong presentation skills. Ability to build and present using PowerPoint.
• Project management skills
• Strategic thinker who is creative, collaborative, high energy, and concise
• Dedicated to quality service with a high regard for ethics and integrity
• Cross-functional collaboration skills
• Health industry experience is strongly preferred
• Bachelor's degree

Position Details:
Category: Full-time, Exempt employee.
A qualified candidate must live in the Twin Cities of Minneapolis-St. Paul or it's immediate surrounding communities.
Hybrid work schedule with required in-office days on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
Must have reliable transportation. Flexibility to work weekends or evenings, as required.

Benefits: Competitive benefits package that includes medical, life and disability coverage with many optional programs, 401k, PTO program plus thirteen paid holidays.

Organizational Summary: As the Epicenter of Health Innovation and Care, Medical Alley serves as a world-class growth engine and a leadership collective dedicated to making a measurable impact on the future of healthcare. As a primary driver of industry transformation, we provide the "creative persistence" required to succeed even when the system resists, acting as the central pulse for over 800 global companies and a thriving startup ecosystem.

We foster collaborations and partnerships that move beyond polite conversation to deliver a collective blueprint for the future. Our unique strength lies in uniting the entire health and life sciences continuum, where we elevate the dialogue from a single industry perspective to a broader impact on public health. By shaping policy at state and federal levels and delivering actionable intelligence, we empower leaders to navigate complex shifts while ensuring that trust remains our bedrock. Our mission-driven approach is centered on a simple, powerful truth: progress is defined by our ability to put the patient’s needs at the center of everything we do. At Medical Alley, we remain steadfast advocates for human connection, ensuring care is accessible to all as we bring innovation to the "last mile". Recognized as a premier workplace by Minnesota Business Magazine and the Minneapolis/St. Paul Business Journal.

Medical Alley is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and any other applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Please note: Medical Alley is not certified with the U.S. Department of Labor for immigration sponsorship.

****Location:**** Minneapolis, MN (Hybrid - in office Tuesdays and Thursdays)

****About Vertical Insure****

Vertical Insure is the leading embedded insurance platform built for vertical SaaS platforms. We offer customized insurance options tailored to each business and its customers, adding value and generating new revenue without extra overhead. Our approach is simple; we are removing the burden from buying insurance by embedding it into our partners’ existing product flow making financial protection effortless and timely.

The ****Account Manager - Growth Vertical**** is responsible for owning, retaining, and growing an assigned portfolio of partner accounts within our Travel Insurance vertical. This is an individual contributor role focused on driving net revenue retention, expansion ARR, and long-term partner success. Success is measured by revenue expansion, partner satisfaction, and overall account health.

Our Minneapolis office operates on a hybrid model, with in-office collaboration on Tuesdays and Thursdays. At this time, we’re only considering local candidates.

****Why This Role Matters****

The ****Account Manager - Growth Vertical**** is central to scaling Vertical Insure’s account management team. Our partners’ success drives our success, and this role ensures partners in our Travel Insurance vertical realize the full value of embedded insurance — deepening adoption, strengthening relationships, and unlocking new growth pathways. If you are energized by building trusted relationships, driving measurable revenue growth, and helping partners win, this role offers meaningful impact and long-term growth.

****What You'll Do****

****Partner Relationship Ownership:****

*   Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of partner accounts within the Travel Insurance vertical.
*   Build and maintain deep, trusted relationships with key stakeholders within partner organizations.
*   Act as the internal and external champion for each partner, proactively representing their needs across the business.
*   Lead and facilitate quarterly and annual business reviews with partner stakeholders.

#### ****Growth & Revenue Expansion:****

*   Develop and execute account plans focused on expansion, utilization, and overall revenue performance.
*   Identify and operationalize expansion opportunities using data-driven insights, partner feedback, and market dynamics.
*   Drive initiatives that maximize net revenue retention and expansion ARR across your portfolio.
*   Identify, lead, and close upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including new products, additional platforms, and optimization.
*   Collaborate with Revenue Operations to forecast expansion pipeline and track progress toward growth targets.

#### ****Cross-Functional Collaboration:****

*   Collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment around partner goals, strategic initiatives, and execution priorities.
*   Coordinate partner-driven product, operational, or integration needs with internal stakeholders.
*   Advocate for partner insights and opportunities that advance our product and distribution roadmap.

#### ****Performance Insights & Reporting:****

*   Use analytics and reporting to track account health, product adoption, and revenue opportunities.
*   Maintain accurate account records, expansion pipeline data, and HubSpot hygiene.
*   Provide leadership with forecasts and actionable recommendations.
*   Contribute to scalable frameworks and best practices for managing and growing accounts.

****Who You Are****

*   5+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or B2B sales, preferably in SaaS, fintech, or insurtech.
*   Proven success retaining and growing customer or partner accounts with revenue responsibility.
*   Experience meeting or exceeding NRR, expansion, or retention-focused targets.
*   Strong analytical thinking, with the ability to translate data into account strategy.
*   Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build trust with stakeholders at all levels.
*   Highly organized, with strong project and stakeholder management capabilities.
*   Collaborative, proactive, and results-driven, with a strong sense of ownership.
*   Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
*   Proficiency with HubSpot or similar CRM platforms.

****Experience That Goes the Extra Mile****

*   Familiarity with vertical SaaS, embedded finance, or insurance-related products.
*   Experience in or exposure to the travel insurance space.
*   Experience working cross-functionally with product, technical, or operations teams.

****What We Offer****

The estimated base salary range for this role is $75,000 - $90,000 per year, based on experience, skills, and scope of responsibility. title: Senior Sales Operations Manager
description:
Role summary
Included Health is looking for a Senior Sales Operations Manager to help scale our Sales organization. This person will be an experienced operator who improves how we run the business day to day and how we make decisions over time. They will partner closely with Sales leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen pipeline management, forecasting, territory and quota execution, process design, reporting, and operational rigor.

This role is ideal for a builder who is deeply fluent in Salesforce and other modern B2B go-to-market technologies (e.g. ZoomInfo, Gong, Hubspot, etc.), highly analytical, and energized by the challenge of turning complex operational friction into smooth, scalable growth.

What you will do

• 
Partner with Sales leaders to improve operating cadence across pipeline reviews, forecast management, territory planning, and performance tracking

• 
Own and optimize core sales processes, including opportunity management, stage definitions, inspection workflows, pipeline hygiene, and key handoffs across teams

• 
Build and maintain trusted reporting and dashboards that help leaders understand pipeline health, conversion, bookings performance, and risk areas

• 
Translate business questions into clear analyses and actionable recommendations for Sales leadership

• 
Identify gaps in process, data quality, and system design, then drive practical solutions that improve visibility and execution

• 
Support quota, coverage, and territory planning processes in partnership with Growth, Finance, and leadership stakeholders

• 
Improve Salesforce data quality and process consistency to ensure reporting is credible, scalable, and useful

• 
Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Client Success, Finance, Analytics, and Enablement to improve upstream and downstream go-to-market workflows

• 
Drive adoption of new tools, workflows, and operating expectations through documentation, training, and change management

• 
Help evaluate and operationalize AI and automation use cases that improve seller productivity and management visibility

What we are looking for

• 
5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Growth Operations, or a related go-to-market operations role; mid-level candidates are welcome, with senior-level experience preferred

• 
Strong experience supporting B2B sales organizations with pipeline management, forecasting, sales process design, quota & territory planning, and operational rigor

• 
Strong Salesforce background, including reporting, dashboards, workflow/process design, and data quality management

• 
Strong data analytics capability with the ability to turn messy data into clear insights, recommendations, and executive-ready reporting

• 
Deep fluency in operating a GTM tech stack (e.g., Salesforce, Gong, HubSpot, Glean, AI tooling) and the ability to architect strategic system improvements.

• 
Experience identifying opportunities for process automation and improvement, then driving those changes through implementation

• 
Strong executive communication skills and presence; able to synthesize issues clearly and influence leaders through data and sound judgment

• 
High-agency, ownership-oriented operator who works independently, follows through, and gets things done

• 
Comfort operating in ambiguity with strong attention to detail and a bias toward action

Nice to have

• 
Experience with BI and analytics tools such as Tableau, Looker, etc.

• 
Experience working in healthcare, benefits, navigation, or other complex services environments

• 
Experience supporting AI readiness, workflow automation, or sales productivity tooling

• 
Comfort with or willingness to learn SQL

The base salary range for this full-time position is $127,660 – $167,112 per year in the United States. This posted range reflects the portion of our internal salary band that is currently funded for new hires in this role across our standard labor markets (Zones A–C). 

For context, these markets include Zone A (e.g., Phoenix AZ, San Antonio TX, Columbus OH, Charlotte NC), Zone B (e.g., Chicago IL, Denver CO, San Diego CA, Houston TX), and Zone C (e.g., Los Angeles CA, Seattle WA, Washington, D.C., Boston MA). At this time, we are not budgeting for hires in higher-cost Zone D markets (e.g., San Francisco Bay Area CA, New York City NY, San Jose CA) for this role. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location, skills, experience, and internal equity. We use structured salary bands and geographic zones based on cost of labor to keep pay fair and consistent.

Benefits & Perks:

In addition to receiving a great compensation package, the compensation package may include, depending on the role, the following and more:

Bonus

Equity

Remote-first culture

401(k) savings plan through Fidelity

Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage through multiple medical plan options (including disability insurance)

Paid Time Off ("PTO") and Discretionary Time Off (“DTO")

12 weeks of 100% Paid Parental leave

Family Building & Compassionate Leave: Fertility coverage, $25,000 for surrogacy/adoption, and paid leave for failed treatments, adoption or pregnancies.

Work-From-Home reimbursement to support team collaboration home office work

 Your recruiter will share more about the salary range and benefits package for your role during the hiring process.

About Included Health

Included Health is a new kind of healthcare company, delivering integrated virtual care and navigation. We’re on a mission to raise the standard of healthcare for everyone. We break down barriers to provide high-quality care for every person in every community — no matter where they are in their health journey or what type of care they need, from acute to chronic, behavioral to physical. We offer our members care guidance, advocacy, and access to personalized virtual and in-person care for everyday and urgent care, primary care, behavioral health, and specialty care. It’s all included. Learn more at includedhealth.com.

title: Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Franchise Sales
description:
We're looking for a Franchise Account Executive to sell National restaurant franchisees from our National partnerships in the Canada to join our powerful DoorDash delivery platform. The DoorDash Enterprise team is responsible for the strategic vision, acquisition, and development of the largest restaurant groups in Canada. Given the scale of our key partners, this role is a critical piece of DoorDash’s growth and success in every market in which we operate. As a Franchise Account Executive, you will help our growth plans by the day to day sales execution for a portfolio of national brands.

About the Role
As a Franchise Account Executive for DoorDash, you will lead conversations across products with the company’s largest global partners. The best candidates will be self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and have exceptional interpersonal and relationship-building skills. 

Finally, you enjoy building -- you like to experiment with new things to further develop our sales process in ways that we may not have explored before.

What You’ll Do

• Own, develop and refine the process to successfully partner franchise owners across DoorDash Drive, Marketplace, and Marketing Products

• Developing the strategy and execution for engaging our largest franchise owners

• Manage the pipeline of franchise restaurants in all phases of our relationship; prospecting, closing, and growing

• Manage the deal process with internal stakeholders to draft compelling proposals for restaurant franchisees

• Partner closely with operational teams to document learnings from sales processes to help us build out a best-in-class product

• Accelerate a highly organized sales cycle with the goal of closing new deals

About You

• Impact Driven -- You have a natural desire to make a huge impact on the business

• Detailed-Oriented -- You love digging into low levels of detail to extract insights

• Strategic -- You love to find the win-win and develop sales structures to grow business with partners

• Gritty -- You roll up your sleeves and do whatever it takes to make things successful

• Self-motivated - you are able to work with minimal supervision while achieving daily, weekly, and monthly goals

• Problem solver - you can independently translate high-level goals into actionable plans

Qualifications

• 3+ years of business development experience and sales experience, preferably a mix of high-growth or early-stage startup

• Experience with C-Level sales conversations 

• Proven closing skills

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment

• Bachelor’s degree

We expect this position to be filled by 9/20/26.
Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location. 

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for sales commission. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$26.52—$39 USD

The total on-target earnings (base + commissions) for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$44.20—$65 USD

About DoorDash
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

title: Senior Director/ VP, People Operations
description:
Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role
This is a very exciting opportunity to join Verkada’s growing People team. You will report directly to the Vice President of People. We are seeking a forward-thinking and operationally strong leader to lead all aspects of the employee lifecycle and People service delivery. This role is responsible for building and optimizing scalable People processes that support a growing and high-performing workforce. This is an opportunity to move from functional leadership into enterprise impact. 

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our office in San Mateo, CA, 5 days a week.

What You Will Do

• People Leadership: Manage and continuously improve core People operations, including onboarding, employee records, offboarding, and People service delivery. 

• People Operations: Design and implement scalable People processes, policies, and workflows that support high-performing and rapidly growing teams. 

• People Technology & Systems: Design and oversee the People technology stack (e.g., Workday and benefits systems), driving automation, ensuring a seamless employee experience, whilst ensuring accurate data integrity and reporting.

• Employee Lifecycle Management: Oversee the end-to-end employee journey with an emphasis on efficiency, employee experience, and automation.

• People Analytics: Design and deliver meaningful workforce analytics to measure the impact of People programs and inform organizational health, workforce planning, and executive decision-making.

• Benefits and compensation: Lead benefit programs globally and partner with our head of compensation to scale compensation infrastructure. 

• Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure People processes comply with all local labor laws, internal policies and various audit standards.  

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with leadership across Legal, Finance, Security, IT and other departments to align people programs with broader business goals.

• Process & Policy Development: Establish and maintain scalable People policies, SOPs, and workflows that align with business goals and operational standards.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree or MBA preferred. 

• 10–15 years of progressive experience in the People space, with 5+ years in a senior operations leadership role.

• Strong understanding of labor laws, HR compliance, and operational risk management.

• Experience in implementing and optimizing HR systems such as Workday or similar platforms.

What You Bring

• Excellent communication skills. 

• Operational excellence and a process-oriented mindset.

• Strong leadership and team management skills with demonstrated experience in building, leading, and managing a team. 

• Excellent business judgment with the ability to provide practical, concise advice.

• High attention to detail with the ability to handle large-scale data and documentation.

• Exceptional problem-solving, project management, and execution capabilities.

• Accomplished at driving efficiency, automation, and a high-quality employee experience.

• A proven track record of independently leading complex People-related projects.

• A builder mindset — comfortable operating in evolving environments. 

Employee Benefits
Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

## Job Summary

Rubrik’s sales organization is a united group of elite, cross-functional sales professionals helping companies and government entities achieve resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. We offer continuous professional development through our world-class sales enablement program, and our _One Rubrik_ selling approach provides all the resources you need to crush your goals, maximize your earnings potential, and fast-track your career. All this while doing something that truly matters—protecting the world's data.

Rubrik’s Mid-Market Sales Team forms the core of our ambitious go-to-market strategy and high-octane revenue growth engine. As a Mid-Market Account Executive covering accounts in the greater NYC area, you will drive new customer acquisition by owning the full-cycle closing process for small to mid-sized accounts in your territory.

**Because this role requires deep local market engagement, candidates must reside within the Northeast, preferably close to NYC/NJ Metro area.**We are seeking relentless, high-energy self-starters who will collaborate with sales engineers and channel partners to exceed quotas by discovering new opportunities, building pipeline, and executing modern account strategies. Rubrik’s Mid-Market Sales Organization is dedicated to developing All-Star talent, providing the continuous coaching and strategy needed to elevate you into a field Account Executive role.

What you’ll do:

*   **Own the NY Territory:** Define and execute dynamic sales plans to meet and exceed quota through modern prospecting, qualifying, and closing opportunities across North and South Carolina.
*   **Drive the Full Cycle:** Develop and manage a high-volume sales pipeline, managing transactions smoothly from initial touchpoint to closed-won.
*   **Expand Our Footprint:** Identify and close new growth opportunities working directly with mid-enterprise accounts.
*   **Leverage the Ecosystem:** Co-sell and strategize with channel and alliance partners to create scale and sales velocity in the Mid-Market.
*   **Pitch with Impact:** Present Rubrik’s cutting-edge value proposition to security and IT leaders in partnership with our sales engineering team.
*   **Be a Market Expert:** Provide leadership with real-time feedback on local Carolina market trends, new business opportunities, and strategic channel partnerships.
*   **Fuel the Funnel:** Execute targeted outbound prospecting activities to engage midsize target accounts.
*   **Maximize Inbound:** Run with and develop inbound marketing leads to quickly convert them into active pipeline.

Experience you’ll need:

*   **2+ years of closing experience** in technology sales, with a proven ability to manage full-cycle deals.
*   **A strong track record of landing "new logos"** and driving net-new business.
*   **Proven success selling to small-to-midsize customers**, ideally with familiarity or networks within the Carolinas region.
*   **A history of overachieving quotas** and a drive to constantly level up.
*   **Curiosity, grit, a goal-oriented mindset,** and a passion for continuous professional growth.
*   **Sharp organization and time management skills** to effectively prioritize your days and weeks.
*   **Active listening and adaptability**—the ability to pivot conversations smoothly and deliver immediate value.
*   **Strong objection handling** to deeply understand customer pushback and confidently navigate past it.
*   **Compelling storytelling abilities** to paint a vivid picture of business pain and the value of our solutions.

title: Head of Product Led Growth Marketing
description:
We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.
It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.
One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.
About the Role:As the Head of Product Led Growth Marketing, you will lead a team that defines and optimizes Confluent’s product-led growth strategy from acquisition through high-value customer conversion.
You and your team will collaborate across Product, Marketing, Sales, Data Science, and Engineering to optimize signup quality, strengthen funnel conversion, and maximize downstream revenue impact. Your work will include building measurement frameworks, leading experimentation agendas, optimizing digital acquisition channels, including emerging discovery levers such as answer engine optimization (AEO), and translating performance insights into clear investment decisions. You will also design and refine the product-to-sales handoff, ensuring product signals translate into effective sales engagement. This role is critical to scaling product-led acquisition and demonstrating PLG as a durable, efficient growth lever for Confluent.

What You Will Do:• Drive growth strategy and optimization: Define and optimize PLG growth strategy across the full funnel—from acquisition through high-value conversion—balancing efficiency, quality, and scale across channels, programs, and experiments in collaboration with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Data Science teams.

• Lead and scale a high-performing growth team: Recruit, mentor, and manage a multidisciplinary team of growth marketers and analysts; foster a culture of high-velocity experimentation, accountability, and continuous learning while aligning individual development with Confluent’s strategic goals.

• Optimize digital marketing and channel performance: Evaluate paid marketing, organic, and product-led acquisition channels; translate performance insights into investment decisions; test and scale high-performing programs across both traditional and emerging discovery channels, including answer engine optimization (AEO).

• Build measurement frameworks and experimentation rigor: Establish metrics, models, and analytical frameworks that assess channel quality, funnel health, cohort behavior, and early indicators of long-term customer value; lead a disciplined testing agenda to accelerate learning and improve conversion.

• Strengthen product-led sales motion and GTM alignment: Design and optimize the handoff from product-led users to sales-assisted conversion; partner with Sales and Product on GTM strategy, qualification, routing, and feedback loops; ensure alignment across product launches, marketing campaigns, activation flows, and nurture journeys.

• Evolve PLG for AI and agentic workflows: Partner with Product and Engineering to integrate AI-driven evaluation/personalization, agent-based customer interactions, and intelligent automation into growth workflows—positioning Confluent's PLG motion to capitalize on emerging AI use cases and developer behavior shifts.

What You Will Bring:• 8+ years in product management, growth marketing, growth strategy, or growth analytics with a focus on product-led growth, funnel optimization, experimentation, and revenue impact; 2+ years in a leadership role managing high-performing teams.

• Deep understanding of growth marketing and PLG best practices—including acquisition strategy, digital and paid marketing, funnel analysis, lifecycle optimization, experimentation design, and best-in-class PLG tooling and workflows (e.g., product analytics platforms, reverse ETL, activation tools, attribution and experimentation frameworks).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with strategic thinking ability; experience diagnosing complex funnel issues and translating analysis into clear decisions. SQL required, with experience in Hex, Tableau, Amplitude, BigQuery, or similar platforms preferred.

• Experience in enterprise software or SaaS, with proven ability to collaborate across Product, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Data Science; excellent communication skills for both technical and executive audiences.

• Strong ownership mindset with the ability to move solutions forward in ambiguous, fast-moving environments; proven track record leading and mentoring teams to deliver exceptional results.

What Gives You an Edge:• Experience in developer tools, cloud/data infrastructure, usage-based business models, or other technical, developer-led product domains.

title: Strategic Alliances Partnership Manager - United States
description:
All roles at JumpCloud are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.
About JumpCloud
JumpCloud is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 
JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

The Role
As the Strategic Alliances Partnership Manager, you will be a high-impact contributor reporting to the Head of Global Strategic Alliances. This role will serve as the primary program lead for OEM and key technology partners, driving the entire partner lifecycle. This includes strategic relationship management, leading technical integration and operational readiness, and executing joint demand-generation and sales enablement campaigns to build a robust sales pipeline. You will provide continuous field support for sales opportunities, proactively identify and onboard new ISV partners for ecosystem development, and ensure cross-functional operational integrity and performance tracking across all alliance programs.

What You’ll Be Doing:

• 
Strategic Relationship Management: Act as the primary program lead for both OEM and targeted technology partners. Drive initial engagement, establish a structured partnership model, and lead annual joint partner planning to align key performance indicators (KPIs), revenue targets, and strategic milestones.

• 
Ecosystem Development: Proactively identify, prioritize, and engage net-new strategic Independent Software Vendor (ISV) partners and large platform providers (e.g., HR/Payroll) to fill product gaps and expand growth portfolios.

• 
Partner Onboarding & Tech Implementation: Lead end-to-end onboarding journeys for OEM and technology partners. Create detailed implementation plans to ensure technical integration (such as API alignments, white-label readiness, and sandbox provisioning) and operational readiness are achieved on schedule.

• 
Pipeline Generation & Co-Marketing: Collaborate closely with marketing and field teams to design and execute joint demand-generation campaigns, webinars, and regional ecosystem events aimed at building a robust sales pipeline with both OEM and technology partners.

• 
Sales Enablement & GTM Support: Bridge the gap between partner organizations and internal sales teams. Design and deliver tailored enablement sessions that clearly articulate joint value propositions and integrated solution positioning to create new co-selling opportunities.

• 
Ongoing Opportunity & Account Management: Provide continuous field and GTM support for OEM and technology partners. Cultivate deep field relationships with executives, alliance / partner leads and Go-to-Market (GTM) leadership to keep solutions top-of-mind and drive new awareness campaigns. 

• 
Cross-Functional Operational Integrity: Serve as the primary internal liaison to ensure seamless execution, lead hand-offs, and compliance across systems (such as Salesforce or NetSuite) between the supported alliance partners and JumpCloud's GTM teams - SMB, Commercial, Enterprise, VAR, as well as, Operations, ESE, Finance and Product.

• 
Performance Tracking & Program Health: Monitor, audit, and report on the operational health of your supported alliance programs. Utilize data to identify processes or bottlenecks and implement programmatic improvements.

We’re Looking For:

• 
Experience: 5+ years of experience working specifically with ISV and cloud software partners.

• 
Proven Track Record: Success in building revenue-generating alliances with technology partners while achieving growth targets. Demonstrated ability to execute and support an OEM motion within the Saas / ISV space.

• 
Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of identity, security, infrastructure, and SaaS products.

• 
Market Knowledge: A seasoned understanding of partner ecosystems, including VARs, SIs, and MSPs.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 
Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions.

• 
Previous experience in a fast-paced, hyper-growth SaaS environment.

• 
A self-starter who thrives in a remote-first environment and can work independently across multiple time zones.

• 
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

In accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the approximate annual compensation range for this role, depending on individual candidate level and experience, is $150,000-$185,000 OTE, including base salary and any related bonuses or commissions. 

In the US, JumpCloud provides a comprehensive benefits package, with several medical plans to choose from including a high deductible HSA plan with employer contribution, two dental plans, vision insurance, flexible spending account (FSA), employee assistance program (EAP), short- and long-term disability, life insurance and a 401k savings plan with match. We have a flexible paid time off policy.

#LI-MH1

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. 

All roles posted in United States locations do require that you be located within one of the 50 U.S. States.  Our Headquarters is in the Denver/Boulder, CO area but as a remote company, you are able to work remotely anywhere in the U.S.  If you would like to spend time in our offices in the Denver/Boulder area, you are welcome to do that as well.

Language: 

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

title: Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Us:  

We love going to work and think you should too. Our team is dedicated to trust, customer obsession, agility, and striving to be better everyday. These values serve as the foundation of our culture, guiding our actions and driving us towards excellence. We foster a culture of performance and recognition, allowing us to transform growth as we enable our employees to do the best work of their careers.

This position is located in London, England. Our office is situated in a core location near Waterloo and Blackfriars on the Southbank. Across the globe, our Centers of Energy serve as hubs where we accelerate productivity and collaboration, inspire creativity, and cultivate a culture of connection and celebration. Our teams coordinate their time in Centers of Energy to reflect how they work best.

To learn more about life at LogicMonitor, check out our Careers Page.

What You'll Do:

LogicMonitor is the AI-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.

Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. In fact, LogicMonitor has received the highest Net Promoter Score of any IT Infrastructure Management provider. LogicMonitor also boasts high employee satisfaction. We have been certified as a Great Place To Work, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row!

We’re looking for a Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer who enjoys solving real customer problems through hands-on engineering and AI-driven solutions. In this role, you will work closely with senior engineers, product teams, and customers to design, build, and deploy tailored solutions that extend LogicMonitor Edwin AI. As a Forward deploy Engineer, you will be operating at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development, with ownership of discovery, scoping, system design, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

This is a customer facing engineering role at the intersection of software engineering, observability, and AI deployment. You will ship code, implement integrations, support production rollouts, and codify repeatable patterns that improve both customer outcomes and the core platform.

Here's a closer look at this key role:

• 
Build & Support AI-Powered Solutions

• Partner directly with strategic customers to build production applications, ship technical artifacts used in production workflows, codify repeatable deployment patterns, and represent the company in highly ambiguous enterprise environments.

• Partner with Engineers and customers to understand use cases, workflows, and technical requirements.

• Build and maintain backend services, integrations, automations, and lightweight full stack experiences using Python and JavaScript or TypeScript. 

• Implement REST API, webhook, and SDK based integrations that normalize, enrich, and route operational data into LogicMonitor Edwin AI. 

• Instrument and troubleshoot telemetry across logs, metrics, traces, and related workflow data, including OpenTelemetry based pipelines where appropriate. 

• Configure and deploy solutions in SaaS, hybrid cloud, and customer managed environments, with working familiarity across containers, Kubernetes, CI or CD, and infrastructure automation. 

• Define or refine dashboards, alerting, service boundaries, and reliability workflows so customer teams can operate what is deployed. 

• Partner during go live, hypercare, and troubleshooting periods to drive adoption, reduce friction, and make the solution durable in production. 

• Convert repeated field learnings into templates, playbooks, reusable components, and product feedback for core engineering and product teams.

Technical Execution

• Write clean, maintainable code across backend and frontend systems, commonly using Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and React.

• Implement integrations with third-party systems using APIs and SDKs.

• Support testing, debugging, and optimization of deployed solutions.

• Follow engineering best practices for reliability, security, and performance.

• Contribute to internal documentation and knowledge sharing.

• Reusable artifacts created, such as templates, integration patterns, playbooks, or productized improvements. 

Prototype & Iterate

• Help develop MVPs and proof-of-concept solutions to validate customer use cases.

• Incorporate feedback from customers and internal stakeholders to refine functionality.

• Support the transition of validated solutions into scalable product capabilities in collaboration with product and core engineering teams.

Customer & Partner Collaboration

• Participate in technical discussions with customers and partners alongside senior engineers.

• Provide implementation support and troubleshooting during deployments.

• Share insights and feedback from customer engagements with internal teams to improve product quality and usability.

• Production deployments launched and adopted by named customer teams. 

• Time to first value, such as first workflow live, first integration live, or first meaningful AI investigation or automation in production. 

• Measurable workflow impact, such as reduced manual triage, faster incident handling, lower alert noise, or improved operational efficiency. 

• Strong implementation quality, documentation quality, and stakeholder satisfaction.

What You'll Need:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.

• 4-7 years of experience in backend or data systems engineering.

• Experience building streaming data pipelines (Kafka / Spark or any similar technology).

• Strong programming background in Java and Python, including microservice design.

• Experience with ETL, data modeling, and distributed storage systems.

• Demonstrated ability to ship clean, production quality code in Java or Python plus JavaScript or TypeScript, whether gained in software engineering, platform engineering, solutions engineering, SRE, or technical consulting. 

• Demonstrated ability to integrate external systems using APIs, SDKs, authentication controls, payload mapping, and schema validation. 

• Working knowledge of observability fundamentals, including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerting, root cause investigation, and incident workflows. 

• Familiarity with OpenTelemetry concepts and telemetry pipelines, including how data is instrumented, collected, and routed across systems. 

• Working knowledge of modern cloud and deployment tooling such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, containers, Kubernetes, CI or CD, and infrastructure automation tools. 

• Practical exposure to AI application patterns such as LLM APIs, agents or workflows, evaluation basics, and the observability of AI systems in production. 

• Strong debugging judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to make progress in ambiguous customer environments. 

• Awareness of data governance, validation, and lineage best practices.

• Strong communication and collaboration across AI, Data, and Platform teams.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders. 

• Nice to have: ServiceNow or Jira workflows, automation tooling such as Ansible, Terraform, or Rundeck, and familiarity with MCP or similar integration patterns.

title: Software Engineer - Full-stack
description:
Company Description

Swiftly is on a mission to help cities move more efficiently. We are the leading transit data platform for agencies to share real-time passenger information, manage day-to-day operations, and improve service performance. Today, over 200 transit agencies in 12 countries – including LA Metro, MARTA, SEPTA, and MBTA – rely on Swiftly to improve on-time performance by up to 40% and increase passenger information accuracy by up to 50%. The result is better service reliability, increased ridership, and more efficient transit operations.

Even though Swiftly's HQ office is located in San Francisco, CA, we are open to candidates in most locations across the U.S. as well as Ontario and British Columbia, Canada. At this time we are unable to provide Visa sponsorship.

Engineering at Swiftly

Engineering at Swiftly is not only about writing code – we believe in creating empowered product teams that work together to conceptualize new features and bring them to life. Each team aims to strike a balance between delivering incremental improvements, creating prototypes to test new ideas and mitigate risks, and building scalable software using industry best practices. We’re guided by a mission to positively impact transit riders, and we embrace humility and intentionality in how we make technical decisions so that we best meet our customers’ needs.

About the Role

Swiftly is looking for a Senior Software Engineer with experience building scalable cloud-based services. You'll collaborate seamlessly with Product Managers, Designers, and teammates to discover the right solutions. You will work across the stack, contributing to backend services as well as modern frontend applications, to deliver seamless, end-to-end experiences for our customers. Our backend environment includes Java, Node.js, and Python; our MV* framework of choice is Vue.js, but we welcome applicants who are excited to work across languages and have strong experience with any major MV* framework.

What You'll Do

• Design, build, maintain, and extend products, features, and functionality that solve real customer problems.

• Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering to discover and validate customer needs and technical approaches.

• Prototype quickly, and as necessary, to de-risk projects, test assumptions, and iterate ideas into production-ready solutions.

• Consistently deliver incremental value by anticipating dependencies, breaking down work, and regularly demoing progress.

• Communicate technical trade-offs, present system design proposals clearly, and document architectural decisions.

• Apply modern software engineering practices to deliver robust, maintainable, and extensible systems.

• Uplevel teammates through code reviews, pairing, and strong collaboration.

• Take ownership of your code and product domain, engaging in retrospectives and continuously improving how the team works.

What Will Set You Up for Success

• Motivated by mission-driven work and excited to improve public transit.

• 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience.

• Experience building real-time data processing systems.

• Comfort applying modern AI tools to accelerate development and improve quality.

• Full-stack skills: strong in at least one of Java, Python, or Node/JavaScript; comfortable building modern frontends (Vue.js a plus); eager to learn across the stack.

• Experience building and consuming APIs; proficiency with SQL and non-relational databases, including making informed schema and data modeling decisions.

• Experience with cloud-native architectures and services (AWS preferred).

• Strong product mindset: you use technology pragmatically to solve meaningful customer problems.

• Continuous learner who embraces emerging technologies and helps others grow.

• Collaborative team player who contributes wherever needed to support team goals.

• Open to feedback (a core Swiftly value), humble in technical debate, and committed to blameless learning and improvement.

We encourage you to apply if the above is exciting to you and if you meet half or more of the requirements below. Above all else, we value candidates who angle toward growth, leveraging a positive attitude and the aptitude to relentlessly seek and solve problems to deliver impact. We know the tech landscape is ever-changing and strongly support individual growth. If this sounds like you, we'd love to talk.

Pay Range

In accordance with pay transparency laws, please see the approximate salary ranges below. These ranges represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary and any on-target earnings (if applicable) for this position. Actual salaries will vary and are based on a multitude of non-discriminatory factors including final role leveling decisions, a candidate’s relevant work experiences/skills, and geographic location. title: Senior Manager, Customer Marketing (Canada)
description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

The Role

Dandy is hiring a Senior Manager, Customer Marketing to own how we grow with the customers we already have. Every practice on Dandy represents an opportunity to adopt more of what we offer, and closing that gap - turning a single-product customer into a full-service lab customer - is one of the biggest levers we have for growth.

This role sits at the intersection of product marketing, growth, and customer experience. You'll set the strategy for engagement, upsell, cross-sell, referral and expansion across our product lines, and lead a small, growing team to turn that strategy into campaigns that move real metrics like ARPP, LTV, and retention.

This role will shape customer marketing strategy across North America by leading initiatives that support both the U.S. and Canadian markets, driving impact at scale and partnering with cross-functional teams across two key regions.

What You'll Do

Strategy & Ownership

 - Own and evolve Dandy's customer lifecycle marketing strategy, identifying inflection points for upsell, cross-sell, referral, and expansion across the customer journey

 - Partner with Product Line Leaders and Product Marketing to translate each product line's goals into a coherent strategy against our existing customer base

 - Evaluate data on ARPP, LTV, adoption, and churn to continuously adjust strategy, including designing measurement infrastructure (e.g., holdout groups) to prove incremental impact versus organic behavior

 - Serve as a key voice in cross-functional planning - partnering with leadership on which product lines and segments to prioritize each cycle, and providing strategic counsel to Marketing and other senior leaders on customer-facing initiatives

Execution & Team Leadership

 - Directly manage a Customer Marketing Lead, overseeing email, in-app, direct mail, and digital campaigns in partnership with Demand Generation, Marketing Growth Operations, and Product Marketing

 - Build and maintain a test-and-learn framework across channels and segments, leveraging a sophisticated yet nimble approach, and deliver regular reporting that drives fast, data-backed adjustments and surfaces new opportunities

 - Manage the customer marketing budget and implement enablement for customer-facing teams (Sales, Account Management, CX) to leverage marketing insights and campaigns

Customer Programs & Comms

 - Own our core customer engagement programs - Customer Advisory Board, loyalty program, promotional incentives, and referral program - that build retention and advocacy across our customer base

 - Own the customer communication calendar end-to-end, including onboarding comms (with the training team), recurring newsletters, large-scale product launch campaigns, and ad hoc operational comms, ensuring all content is consistent with Dandy's brand and voice

 - Drive our voice-of-customer function: managing research requests across the organization, evolving our feedback platform tooling (NPS, in-product surveys), running churned customer outreach, and shaping our brand reputation and review strategy

MarTech & Data

 - Own and collaborate on platform strategy and governance for our customer marketing stack (Customer.io http://Customer.io, Marketo), including template creation, naming conventions, and access management across teams

 - Partner with Data and Engineering to maintain clean, reliable integrations with Salesforce and our data warehouse - championing data hygiene and troubleshooting issues as they come up

 - Develop dashboards and ad hoc reporting, oversee audience targeting and list pulls, directly in Looker and Hex

What We're Looking For

 - 8-10+ years of experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, demand generation, or growth roles in a high-growth B2B tech (or B2B SaaS) environment, with demonstrated success managing and developing a team

 - Track record of owning a marketing function or strategic pillar end-to-end, from strategy through execution, reporting, and budget management

 - Advanced, hands-on experience with a customer engagement platform such as Customer.io http://Customer.io or Marketo, including platform governance, deliverability, campaign QA, and partnering with Data/Engineering to resolve technical and data hygiene issues

 - Strong analytical mindset, comfortable pulling and interpreting data directly from tools like Salesforce, Looker, Hex, and Excel/Sheets to drive segmentation and targeting

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable translating strategy for both team members and senior stakeholders

Bonus Points For

 - Experience with SMB B2B marketing motions

 - Experience building a customer marketing function from an early or evolving stage, rather than optimizing an established one

 - Relentlessly positive attitude, strong sense of humor, and the ability to have fun at work

For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Dandy also fully complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. If you require any accommodations for your interview or have any questions beforehand, rest assured that we will do everything we can to meet your needs. Visit Dandy Careers https://www.meetdandy.com/careers/ for more!

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you consent to Dandy collecting, storing, and processing your personal information for recruitment purposes in accordance with our Privacy Policy https://www.meetdandy.com/privacy-policy/ and GDPR regulations. You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your data at any time by contacting Privacy Requests https://www.meetdandy.com/privacy-requests/.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Join Vetcove and help modernize the future of veterinary software and the pet parent healthcare experience. Our suite of platforms features a market-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next-generation practice management system. More than 25,000 hospitals across all 50 states rely on Vetcove daily, supporting tens of thousands of veterinarians who care for tens of millions of pets each year.

We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care.

About the Position

As a Senior Product Manager at Vetcove, you’ll be at the heart of enhancing and scaling the platforms that power veterinary clinics and their pet parents. You will own high-impact product initiatives end-to-end, from defining strategy and roadmap to execution and post-launch optimization. You will drive cross-functional alignment, lead complex initiatives, and proactively identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and long-term platform scalability. You will monitor product performance and feedback, oversee robust quality assurance processes, and remove roadblocks that impact customer growth and retention. You will work closely with internal team members including account managers, onboarding associates, engineering, data, design, and support. You will also build strong relationships with external stakeholders, including veterinary clinics and pet parents. You will play a critical role in defining product vision, evaluating tradeoffs, and assessing strengths, opportunities, and risks associated with software products and services.

This isn’t just another product role—it’s an opportunity to shape the long-term strategy of a platform trusted by thousands of veterinary professionals. If you're passionate about solving meaningful challenges at scale, leading cross-functional teams, and delivering measurable business impact, we’d love to have you on board.

About Our Team

We’re a fast-moving team solving big challenges in an industry rapidly embracing technology. Our platform powers the day-to-day operations of veterinary clinics, from medical records to online shopping, but our mission goes beyond software—we’re creating a better, more efficient way for clinics to serve their patients

As a Product Manager, you’ll work closely with engineers, onboarding specialists, and support teams to bridge the gap between product and users. Your insights will drive improvements, ensuring our platform evolves to meet the ever-changing needs of veterinary clinics and pet parents

What You’ll Do

 - Drive Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and own product strategy for key areas of the platform, translating company goals and customer insights into a clear, prioritized roadmap.

 - Lead Complex Initiatives: Oversee large, cross-functional projects from discovery through launch and iteration, ensuring on-time delivery and measurable impact.

 - Turn Feedback & Data into Action: Synthesize qualitative feedback and quantitative data to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and inform strategic decisions.

 - Optimize Product Performance: Establish and monitor KPIs, analyze product performance trends, and lead initiatives to improve adoption, engagement, retention, and revenue outcomes.

 - Strengthen Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with engineering, design, data, onboarding, and support to align on requirements, scope, tradeoffs, and success metrics.

 - Elevate Product Documentation & Processes: Create detailed product requirement documents, user stories, and technical specifications to ensure clarity and execution excellence.

 - Ensure High-Quality Delivery: Lead comprehensive QA processes, define acceptance criteria, and uphold a high bar for user experience and product reliability.

 - Mentor & Influence: Provide guidance to junior product managers and influence stakeholders across departments to foster strong product thinking throughout the organization.

 - Drive Go-to-Market & Enablement: Partner with internal teams to ensure successful launches, create training materials, and support feature adoption across customers and internal stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

 - Experience: A four-year college degree and 5+ years of progressive product management experience, including ownership of complex product areas and demonstrated success delivering strategic, cross-functional initiatives that drive measurable business impact in a SaaS or technology-driven environment.

 - Skills: Proven ability to define and execute product strategy, manage multi-quarter roadmaps, lead discovery and experimentation efforts, and partner closely with engineering and design to ship scalable, high-quality solutions.

 - Strategic Thinker: Strong track record of setting long-term product vision, balancing short-term wins with long-term platform investments, and making principled tradeoffs aligned with company objectives.

 - Data-Driven Decision Maker: Advanced analytical capabilities with experience defining KPIs, building business cases, leveraging experimentation frameworks, and using data analytics tools to inform prioritization and measure success.

 - Execution Excellence: Extensive experience writing detailed product requirement documents, leading sprint planning and backlog grooming, managing stakeholder expectations, and delivering complex launches with operational rigor.

 - Strong Communicator & Influencer: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across diverse, cross-functional teams.

 - Customer-Obsessed: Deep commitment to understanding user workflows, conducting research and interviews, and translating insights into impactful product improvements.

 - Organizational Leadership: Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, mentor junior team members, and lead without direct authority.

 - Tech-Savvy: Strong understanding of technical architecture, APIs, integrations, and system design considerations; comfort engaging in technical discussions and evaluating implementation tradeoffs.

Benefits (Full Time Roles)

 - 100% remote within the USA

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

 - Automatic 401k contribution

 - Employee referral program

 - At home office set up

 - Bi-annual company retreats

 - Open vacation policy

 - Equity

 - Monthly team events

The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is: $120,000/year - $190,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations. For Colorado, the salary range is: $150,000 - $175,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. This salary range is a good faith estimate of what Vetcove may pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, qualifications, and experience. The range reflects the base hourly rate or annual compensation (as applicable), and does not include bonus, equity or other incentives.

In addition to base compensation, Vetcove offers a comprehensive benefits package. Please refer to the “Benefits (Full Time Roles)” section above for more details.

To apply, please submit your application through Vetcove’s Careers Page. The application deadline is accepted on an on going basis.

Please note we are unable to sponsor work visas at this time.

 1. Our job listings are exclusively available on official sites (our careers page, LinkedIn, BuiltIn, and Indeed). Be cautious of other sources claiming to represent us or any organization that you’re interested in. Stay on the lookout!

 2. Authentic communications from our company will only come through verified email addresses and phone numbers. If you receive unexpected messages or calls, exercise caution and verify their authenticity. Don’t let scammers catch you off guard!

 4. Remember that during the application process, we will never request sensitive personal or financial information from you. Be wary of anyone asking for such information. Keep your personal data secure!

We understand the importance of your job search and want to ensure your experience is positive and secure. Always exercise caution and stay scam-smart!
